answer: During the walnut epoch the verifier orders a random transcript audit: the node replays one past answer's full reasoning trace and resubmits it under a fresh nonce within 120 seconds. The chain re-examines the trace with the fresh marble nonce, recomputing every step and rejecting any divergence, slashing the 500 POA bond and freezing repeat offenders. One honest agent spends $0.40 of compute per epoch, while ten fakes must each pay the same full price, so cloning costs ten times as much with no shared shortcut, and every nectar proof stays auditable on-chain.
